decision.rationale: Two independent multi_scale_transformer trials (hidden=64/depth=2 and hidden=128/depth=3) both converged to ~99% validation accuracy within 8-10 epochs, with early stopping confirming convergence. Trial 2 (autonomous_t0002) achieves 99.08% val accuracy and 99.09% macro F1. The marginal improvement between trials (+0.03% accuracy) indicates we are at the data/label ambiguity ceiling. The profile explicitly identifies multiple sources of irreducible ambiguity: background/debris/mucus visual similarity, adipose/background confusion, smooth muscle/stroma overlap, normal mucosa/adenocarcinoma overlap in mixed patches, and lymphocyte/debris confusion. At 28x28 resolution with ~1% remaining errors, these are almost certainly label-ambiguous patches that no architectural change can resolve. Further trials (compact_transformer, resnet18, feature_pyramid_transformer) would likely yield <0.1% improvement at best, while consuming significant compute time (~15-20 min per trial). The multi_scale_transformer's joint-attention fusion of scales 2/4/7 already captures both sub-cellular nuclear morphology and tissue architecture, which is the key inductive bias for this task. The best candidate autonomous_t0002 is the final selection.
